title: Villager Trade Tweaks
description: Reorder villager trades and have your custom order restored on every visit, view a villager's generated future trades in singleplayer, and re-roll a never-traded villager's trades until you get a set you like.
body:
# PA9 Villager Trade Tweaks

**Take control of your villager trading experience.**

Tired of hunting through a long trade list every session? PA9 Villager Trade Tweaks lets you reorder any villager's trades into whatever order works for you — and automatically restores that order every time you open that villager again. Orders are saved per-villager and per-world, so copied worlds and multiple servers never interfere with each other.

## Features

- **Reorder trades** — Switch to Reorder mode and use Up/Down buttons to arrange any villager's trade list exactly how you want it. Your order saves to disk instantly.
- **View all future trades (singleplayer)** — Enable View All mode to see not just a villager's current offers, but every trade they will unlock as they level up — generated using vanilla's own logic, so what you see is what you'll get.
- **Cycle fresh villagers** — Found a new villager with bad trades? Hit Cycle to re-roll their entire trade set. Works on villagers you've never traded with, and you can keep cycling until you find a set worth keeping.
- **Reset anytime** — One click restores a villager's original order and clears your saved layout.

---

**Requires:** Fabric Loader 0.18.4+, Fabric API, Minecraft 26.1.2
